summary: Add local RFC-style EML parsing, safe visible HTML conversion, attachment inventory, deterministic RFI question/response and Submittal status locators, and output guards for RFI questions and rejected Submittals.
decision_refs: User request to continue improving efficiency, accuracy and adaptability for RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing product rules that RFI questions are not revision directives and Submittals do not silently change contract rights
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested continued product updates covering RFI, Submittal and email content.
known_limitations: Only RFC-style EML files are parsed; Outlook MSG and mailbox-provider connections are not supported.
Attachments are inventoried but not recursively analyzed; users must upload them separately.
Quoted-message segmentation, email thread reconstruction, RFI/Submittal cross-file linking and authority/approval adjudication remain planned.
Validation uses synthetic offline documents only; no customer document or paid provider was used.
